replacement.title: Manuscript Visual Placeholders
replacement.definition: Insert visual placeholders into the supplied manuscript chapters as an independently deliverable representation of planned visual placement.

patches.decision_note: Placeholder insertion is an explicit deliverable that can be completed or evaluated independently from the strategic recommendations.

replacement.title: Chapter Image Tracker Updates
replacement.definition: Update the supplied image tracker for each chapter set to reflect the visual plan.

patches.decision_note: Updating the image tracker is an explicit artifact deliverable that can succeed or fail independently from manuscript placeholders and strategy explanations.
The sample review includes caption guidance, but the supplied evidence does not establish whether captions were independently requested or were merely an incidental part of the sample.
